llm_c3p_pair_xs.parent: llm_c3_rank_xs (dead P0, THESIS §64) — pairwise revival per Aug-14 leads note
llm_c3p_pair_xs.hypothesis: Weekly Bradley-Terry scores from LLM pairwise duels on anonymized numeric PIT cards have residual IC (after vol/momentum/size neutralization) vs 5d forward returns AND beat a GBDT twin on identical inputs
llm_c3p_pair_xs.universe: cards.parquet verbatim from C3 (top-200 by 30d median dollar volume, monthly PIT, 799-sym store)
llm_c3p_pair_xs.construction: k=10 seeded permutation-pairing rounds/week; EVERY pair issued in both orders (A,B)+(B,A) in disjoint prompts; 20 duels/prompt; gpt-5.4-mini temp 0 JSON; BT via MM, 200 iters, alpha=0.5 virtual-opponent prior, log-strength score

holdout: 2026-07-01 — SEALED, virgin for LLM-XS family, one-shot only if P3 passes

probes.P0b_order_swap: base run, 8 seeded weeks (seed 20260817): pooled swap-consistency >=0.60 AND per-week >=0.55 in >=6/8 AND slot-1 pick rate in [0.35,0.65]; STOP else
probes.P0a_determinism: 3-week seeded subset cache-bypassed rerun: instance agreement >=0.90 AND weekly BT-score Spearman >=0.90; STOP else
probes.P0c_slot_invariance: 3-week disjoint seeded subset, instances re-shuffled+re-chunked: instance agreement >=0.80 AND weekly BT-score Spearman >=0.80; STOP else
probes.P0d_cost_checkpoint: infra only: extrapolate P1+P2 spend from P0 tokens; if projected > cap surface to user before P2; registered cost-only de-scope = biweekly Fridays, blind to results
probes.P1_anonymization: 26-week seeded subset named vs anon, identical pairs/orders; named weekly IC > 1.5x anon IC => memorization STOP; primary eval anonymous only
probes.P2_incremental: full anon dev run; weekly residualization on {vol rank, 4w momentum, size rank}; mean residual IC>0 with NW-t>=2.0 AND LLM residual IC >= LightGBM twin (walk-forward, identical features/targets); STOP on either
probes.P3_decile_ls: s43 harness, 5bp+funding: net SR>=0.8, dual-family placebo p<0.05, DSR>0.5 at declared n, >=3/4 subperiods nonneg

llm_c3p_pair_xs.multiplicity: confirmatory n_trials=1 for the P2 primary gate (single frozen pre-registered hypothesis, rail 9); family <=10 ledgered configs and cumulative ledger reported as declared sensitivities; ledger data/llm_pair_xs/trial_ledger.jsonl append-only
llm_c3p_pair_xs.stop_rule: any STOP = dead this cycle; no prompt/k/batch/alpha/field/frequency changes after P0 runs; unresolved-instance rate <0.95/week = infra flag not a tuning license; holdout untouched until registered one-shot

llm_c3p_conf.status: REGISTERED, NOT RUN — deferred to >= 90 sealed weeks (~2027-01) per the recommended option (afk autonomy grant 2026-09-04)
llm_c3p_conf.pipeline: frozen verbatim from llm_c3p_pair_xs: gpt-5.4-mini temp 0, k=10 rounds/week, both orders, BT MM 200 iters alpha 0.5, log-strength, weekly OLS residualization on {vol_ewma20, ret_4w, size_rank}, anonymized cards

gates.primary: residual IC > 0 AND NW-t >= 2.0 (lag 4) on all sealed weeks, anonymized
gates.twin: LLM residual IC >= GBDT twin (refit on dev only) on common weeks

llm_c3p_conf.multiplicity: confirmatory n_trials=1 (frozen hypothesis, virgin weeks); cumulative reported
llm_c3p_conf.trigger: cards.parquet covers >= 90 Fridays after 2025-04-04; extend card store first
